rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the act or process of introducing someone or something.

example.english: The teacher gave us an introduction to the new colleague today.
example.traditional: 老師今日介紹咗新同事畀我哋識。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 gam1 jat6 gaai3 siu6 zo2 san1 tung4 si6 bei2 ngo5 dei6 sik1

rows.note: Use this for a short general explanation or overview of a subject rather than the act of introducing it.

example.english: This page gives an introduction to how the plan works.
example.traditional: 呢頁簡介講清楚個計劃點樣運作。
example.jyutping: ni1 jip6 gaan2 gaai3 gong2 cing1 co2 go3 gai3 waak6 dim2 joeng2 wan6 zok3

rows.note: Use this for a beginner-level introduction to a subject, especially in a course or introductory book.

example.english: This book is an introduction to cooking.
example.traditional: 呢本書係學煮餸嘅入門。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 hai6 hok6 zyu2 sung3 ge3 jap6 mun4

rows.note: Use this for the introductory section of a book, article, or other formal written text.

example.english: The introduction to this book first explains the research background.
example.traditional: 本書引言先交代研究背景。
example.jyutping: bun2 syu1 jan5 jin4 sin1 gaau1 doi6 jin4 gau3 bui3 ging2
